question: How many labels identify a held-out choice of reads on supplied chains of independently found source laws?
inputs: Four archived bare-pattern seeds, inputs 0/1/4, candidate reads 5/6, ordered serial join and a membership-query oracle.
forbidden_inputs: Hidden target wiring, entire target tables, and unrequested target labels are unavailable to the learner. The verifier can see them.
mapping: Partition source inputs by the possible observable outputs, compose local functions, and eliminate incompatible candidates after each requested output.
primary_observable: Number of requested target bits to exact functional identification, with errors scored against raw joined constraints on all unqueried inputs.
comparators_or_controls: Plain complete-table version space with equal prior information; known-wiring XOR; discarded second read; broken shared identity; out-of-family flipped label.
resource_budget: One small CPU experiment, four deterministic first-target replays, three chain lengths, at most 16 targets per length and 512 external inputs per target.
first_executable_signal: A recovered source law reproduces its archived stop and makes a determinate local read on the eight inputs.
stop_rule: Finish the specified finite panel or report failed replay, ambiguous read, mismatched independent check or unresolved target.
nonclaims: Exploratory evidence in a supplied family. No claim of native discovery of boundaries, improved general research throughput or recursive self-improvement.
